roundMeaning: First independent review of the bounded start-position hotfix; this is not a new art round or an R17 closing verdict.
profile: Node contract and MEDIUM terrain collision subset
nativeResolutionMeaning: No raster or browser capture was judged. 0x0 is a non-rendered review sentinel for the required schema field.
scoreMeaning: Binary scoped code and contract acceptance only: 100 means no evidence-backed defect survived within the reviewed hotfix scope. It is not a game quality score.
blindComparison: Not performed. This is an independent, source-aware review of a three-line spawn-interface fix and its regression check, not a visual reference comparison; no stranger preference is claimed.
scope: Determine whether exposing the authored Level.spawnPoints.player as Level.playerSpawn fixes the incorrect new-game and retry location without a source-level regression. Check actual nearby terrain and collision geometry as a supplementary runtime subset. Browser and full-game acceptance remain outside this verdict. Also review the dedicated production-browser capture and CI workflow for concrete apparatus pitfalls; prepared browser assertions are not reported as executed.

cause.observation: Player.init reads level.playerSpawn or level.spawns.player. The baseline Level exposes only spawnPoints.player. Therefore the authored approach placement is ignored and Player keeps constructor default z=8, inside the haiden footprint z=3..14.
cause.independentReproduction: Removed only the new getter from Level.prototype in memory, then imported the unchanged regression check. Actual [0,812,8], authored [0,812,73]; expected assertion failure reports distance 65 versus 0. Repository files were not changed.
cause.sufficiency: Getter returns the existing authoritative placement object. Player.init copies its position and yaw, then aligns Y to terrain; it does not mutate the level position. main.js awaits Level.init before Player.init, and Level.init creates spawnPoints before returning.

evidence.apparatus: Real Level._buildSpawnPoints, Input keydown/update, Player.init/update/respawn and PhysicsWorld; flat terrain at y812 and omitted rendered body.
evidence.limitation: This repository regression check alone cannot establish that the full authored mountain or render loop is traversable.

evidence.apparatus: Fresh Node process, delete Level.prototype.playerSpawn in memory before importing the same regression check.

actual.assertion: new game must use the authored approach spawn

evidence.interpretation: The test distinguishes precisely the missing interface from the proposed getter.

evidence.apparatus: Exact production MEDIUM terrain height-data pipeline (macro/core/splines/carve/erosion/finish/blend), terrain registration, all four production approach stair flights, production outer torii and boundary colliders, Input→Player→Physics at 120 fixed 1/60s updates. Actual Menus.prototype.restart is called, with only intro/pause presentation functions stubbed.
evidence.interpretation: The real terrain Y is approximately 811.98257, not the fixture y812. The player crosses the stair head and outer torii and stays finite; the menu retry resets both player and capsule to the authored position.
evidence.limitation: No rendering, browser scheduling, other world props, enemies, actual menu pointer event or camera update. This narrows the nearby-geometry risk; it is not full-game acceptance.

browserApparatusReview.scope: Independent source review plus executed local HTTP integrity check; no browser result is claimed.

integrity.scope: Independent local HTTP reproduction of capture integrity gate; no browser was launched.

inspectedChecks: serveStatic.origin includes /game2/docs, matching relative publication paths and the URL constructed by the capture.
The webdriver autostart trigger is suppressed before boot, and the visible Enter button is clicked/tapped. readyExpr is an expression rather than a truthy function literal.
Initial player coordinates are sampled after all awaited boot systems and before the engine begins updates. Snapshot z8 versus z73 distinguishes baseline and fixed builds.
The real Input movement state and world-space travel are both asserted. The touch drag begins on the left movement-stick half and exceeds the deadzone.
Pause starts at row0; two ArrowDown events select the third row, retry. Existing Menus.restart consumer calls Player.respawn because Level has no restart method.
A fresh context is created for each keyboard/touch session. Production docs are served unchanged and each local/remote payload hash must match the checked-in file.

The workflow checks code, installs Chromium, records control on the branch, then runs fixed local docs. Main additionally checks actual Pages bytes and behavior. Artifacts upload even after a failure.

pitfallsNotElevatedToFindings.detail: Current index.html has no explicit rel=icon while icon.svg exists. If Chromium requests an absent favicon.ico, row.errors may contain a nonruntime 404 and the zero-error assertion will fail. Native browser was unavailable, so this is not an observed failure or a reason to alter game source preemptively. Preserve actual request evidence and scope any eventual exception narrowly.

Both browser sessions request LOW at 568x320, deviceScaleFactor1. This is a rendered LOW smoke test, not the primary phone/MEDIUM contract or physical-device performance proof. The independent nonrendered geometry subset above used MEDIUM.
The touch session taps Enter and drives movement by CDP touch, but its pause/retry actions use keyboard. It tests touch movement and menu retry, not a complete touch-only menu path.

browserApparatusReview.recommendation: The dedicated CI may run to collect the missing browser evidence. Its result and screenshots must be inspected before claiming the published start fix is verified.
